class: A portal receipt outside headings and short application cards was missed
symptom: The owner manually submitted the application, ADP displayed Application Submitted, and the worker kept its browser open waiting for review instructions.
root_cause: The receipt detector recognized heading/alert confirmations or short job cards, but ADP rendered a plain status label beside a long job description. The generic card length bound correctly excluded that layout, leaving the watcher without accepted evidence.
why_tests_missed: Confirmation tests used heading receipts and short application cards; they did not run the manual-review wait against an authenticated ADP receipt containing the full posting.
fix: Add a portal receipt hook. ADP requires a visible exact submitted label, one matching title section, no active applicant form or draft marker, and independently verified original tenant/requisition metadata. Recheck DOM and URL after the API response. Feed accepted evidence into the existing manual-submission return and context cleanup; preserve generic confirmation bounds and submission gates.
prevention: Test both receipt recognition and the actual manual-review loop ending with submitted status and closed browser context; reject hidden or changed receipts, unrelated jobs, active forms and failed identity checks.
